name: Shared Post-block Source Qualification

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/shared-postblock-source-qualification.yml
      - lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/postblock-combined-receiving.json
  push:
    branches: [lab/shared-core-integration]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/shared-postblock-source-qualification.yml
      - rules-engine/src/**
      - game-server/src/**
      - mtg-sdk/src/main/**
      - lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/postblock-*.json
      - lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/postblock-*.md

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: shared-postblock-source-qualification
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  qualify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    env:
      GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=768m
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@f8a3cce218d9f83db3a2ecd90e41ac3de6cdfd9b

      - name: Bind the exact combined source and unchanged original fixtures
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/reports/shared-postblock-source
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess
          def git(*args):
              return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], text=True).strip()
          manifest_path = pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/postblock-source-extraction.json')
          manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
          fixture_manifest_path = pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/postblock-fixture-receiving.json')
          fixture_manifest = json.loads(fixture_manifest_path.read_text())
          files = manifest['production_files'] + manifest['test_files'] + fixture_manifest['fixture_files']
          actual = {item['path']: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for item in files}
          expected = {item['path']: item.get('receiving_sha256', item.get('sha256')) for item in files}
          original_override_hashes = {}
          for override in fixture_manifest['test_import_overrides']:
              original_override_hashes[override['path']] = expected[override['path']]
              expected[override['path']] = override['receiving_sha256']
          receiving_path = pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/postblock-combined-receiving.json')
          receiving_raw = receiving_path.read_bytes()
          receiving = json.loads(receiving_raw)
          pathlib.Path('build/reports/shared-postblock-source/binding-attempt.json').write_text(json.dumps({
              'requested_head': os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE'], 'actual_head': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'),
              'tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'), 'checkout_status': git('status', '--porcelain'),
              'receiving_manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(receiving_raw).hexdigest(),
          }, indent=2) + '\n')
          for filename, digest in receiving['original_manifests_sha256'].items():

      GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@f8a3cce218d9f83db3a2ecd90e41ac3de6cdfd9b
      - name: Bind exact source, original sixteen cases and separate prospective four
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
          path=pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-receiving.json')
          raw=path.read_bytes(); manifest=json.loads(raw)
          assert manifest['budget_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-budget.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          extra=manifest['additional_budget']
          assert extra['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(extra['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          assert extra['expected_actual_cases']==4
          head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
          tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
          assert head==os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE']
          assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
          subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',manifest['receiving_base'],'HEAD'],check=True)
          for filename,expected in manifest['source_files_sha256'].items():
              assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,filename
          assert len(manifest['stages'])==3 and [s['expected_cases'] for s in manifest['stages']]==[14,2,4]
          original=json.loads(pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-budget.json').read_bytes())
          additional=json.loads(pathlib.Path(extra['path']).read_bytes())
          assert original['expected_actual_cases']==16 and additional['expected_actual_cases']==4
          assert [b['case_names'] for b in manifest['banks'][:2]]==[b['cases'] for b in original['banks']]
          assert manifest['banks'][2]['case_names']==additional['bank']['cases']
          assert [b['class'] for b in manifest['banks']]==[s['class'] for s in manifest['stages']]
          workflow='.github/workflows/attacking-token-defender-qualification.yml'
          source={**manifest['source_files_sha256'],workflow:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(workflow).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
          out=pathlib.Path('build/reports/attacking-token-defenders'); out.mkdir(parents=True)
          (out/'source-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'candidate_head':head,'tree':tree,
              'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':source,
              'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          PY
      - name: Execute original sixteen and separate prospective four complete cases
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          set -o pipefail
          capture_failed=0
          for bank in 'AttackingTokenDefenderChoiceTest:token-defender-14' 'DalkovanEncampmentScenarioTest:dalkovan-2' 'EntryChoiceEventProvenanceTest:entry-event-provenance-4'; do
            class=${bank%%:*}
            stage=${bank#*:}
            just test-class "$class" --rerun --info --stacktrace \
              --max-workers=1 -PkotlinCompileParallelism=1 \
              -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g \
              2>&1 | tee "build/reports/attacking-token-defenders/$stage.log"
            status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
            printf '%s\n' "$status" > "build/reports/attacking-token-defenders/$stage-exit-status.txt"
            # A later invocation of the same Gradle test task can replace its XML directory.
            # Preserve this exact bank immediately, before any subsequent invocation starts.
            python3 - "$stage" <<'PY'
          import json,pathlib,shutil,sys
          manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-receiving.json').read_bytes())
          matches=[item for item in manifest['stages'] if item['stage']==sys.argv[1]]
          assert len(matches)==1
          item=matches[0]; out=pathlib.Path('build/reports/attacking-token-defenders')
          folder=out/'tests'/item['stage']; folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
          shutil.copyfile(out/(item['stage']+'-exit-status.txt'),folder/'exit-status.txt')
          xml=pathlib.Path(item['module'])/'build/test-results/test'/('TEST-'+item['class']+'.xml')
          assert xml.is_file(), 'Missing actual XML immediately after bank '+item['stage']
          shutil.copyfile(xml,folder/xml.name)
          PY
            if [ "$?" -ne 0 ]; then capture_failed=1; fi
          done
          exit "$capture_failed"
      - name: Reconcile raw cases with the unchanged shared collector
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,subprocess
          root=pathlib.Path('.'); out=root/'build/reports/attacking-token-defenders'; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
          path=root/'lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-receiving.json'; raw=path.read_bytes(); manifest=json.loads(raw)
          errors=[]
          try:
              source=json.loads((out/'source-provenance.json').read_text())
              assert source['candidate_head']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['tree']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['manifest_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
              for filename,expected in source['source_sha256'].items():
                  assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,filename
              assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
          except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError) as exc:
              errors.append('Exact receiving source binding failed: '+str(exc))
          # Read only each bank's immediately retained XML and exit status; never refill from a later task.
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('shared_collector','lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/collect-priority-receiving.py')
          collector=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(collector)
          rows,case_errors=collector.collect_case_rows(out,manifest['stages']); errors.extend(case_errors)
          actual=sum(r.get('actual_cases',0) for r in rows)
          if len(rows)!=3 or actual!=20: errors.append('Original16 plus separate prospective4 scope incomplete')
          if sum(r.get('actual_cases',0) for r in rows[:2])!=16: errors.append('Original16 token bank incomplete')
          if len(rows)<3 or rows[2].get('actual_cases',0)!=4: errors.append('Separate prospective4 provenance bank incomplete')
          for bank,row in zip(manifest['banks'],rows):
              if set(row.get('case_names',[]))!=set(bank['case_names']): errors.append('Frozen case identities differ: '+bank['class'])
          (out/'actual-case-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'INCOMPLETE_OR_FAILED' if errors else 'PASS_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_ARTIFACT_REVIEW',
              'stages':rows,'actual_cases':actual,'scope_partition':manifest['scope_partition'],'errors':errors,'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps({'actual_cases':actual,'errors':errors}))
          raise SystemExit(1 if errors else 0)
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: attacking-token-defenders-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/reports/attacking-token-defenders/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
